title: Find files >500MB
command: Get-ChildItem {PATH} -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Length -gt 500MB | Sort Length -Descending | Select FullName,@{N='GB';E={[math]::Round($_.Length/1GB,2)}}
